items.title: Brookfield is in no rush to sell Clarios as it expands beyond cars to data centers
items.summary: Brookfield has owned Clarios for more than seven years. Not only is the PE giant in no rush to sell, but it expects a strategic pivot to turn the battery maker into a much larger business. Wisconsin-based Clarios manufactures batteries for vehicles ranging from passenger cars to trucks to motorboats.
